module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 20

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture20

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 20](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph `G`, `b(G) ≥ n(G) / ⌊deg_avg(G)⌋`, where `b(G)` is
the size of a largest induced bipartite subgraph, `n(G)` is the number of vertices,
and `deg_avg(G) = (∑ v, deg(v)) / n(G)` is the average degree.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture20 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected) :
    let deg_avg : ℝ := (∑ v : α, (G.degree v : ℝ)) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)
    (Fintype.card α : ℝ) / (⌊deg_avg⌋ : ℝ) ≤ (b G : ℝ) := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The number of vertices of `K₃` is 3. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : Fintype.card (Fin 3) = 3 := by decide

/-- The average degree of `K₃` is 2 (every vertex has degree 2 in the complete graph on 3 vertices). -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : averageDegree (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) = 2 := by
  unfold averageDegree; simp [Fintype.card_fin]

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture20

sources_consulted: E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, entries 20 and 50, including their remarks: https://web.archive.org/web/20260726061534/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html
Written on the Wall II definitions, entries 3, 15, 22 and 23, and reference popup 38: https://web.archive.org/web/20260723211215id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/wowIIdefs.js
Written on the Wall II introduction, including the definition of bipartite number: https://web.archive.org/web/20240726225242id_/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowii/list.htm

Local supporting definitions: FormalConjecturesForMathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Induced.lean and Degrees.lean; Mathlib's SimpleGraph degree, induced-subgraph, bipartiteness, coloring and connectedness definitions.
review.notes:
The main theorem faithfully states the source's inequality, with the floor applied to the average degree in the denominator. The finite, nontrivial, connected hypotheses exclude the undefined singleton denominator; decidability assumptions introduce no mathematical restriction.

Scratch checks in /workspace/review/scratch.lean proved positivity of the floored average degree, boundedness and attainment of the supremum defining b, and agreement between the rational averageDegree and the theorem's real-valued expression. Computations checked empty/singleton inputs and K₂, P₃, K₃ and K₄. Both sanity checks were independently verified.

The live source was unavailable, so archived copies were used. The source table marks #20 T*; its accompanying #50 discussion explicitly proves an unfloored forest bound. This qualification does not change the conjecture's stated inequality, and no definite contradictory status record was established.
